description.narrative: World Vision provides assistance in Somalia in several areas. To improve health care, we support 11 health centres in Gabiley, Hargeisa and Baki; we construct sanitation facilities, provide access to clean water and install a waste management system. Nearly eighty thousand people receive essential preventive, promotive and curative care. Among other things, pregnant women are supported and guided through childbirth. Children under five are included in the vaccination programme so that they are protected against diseases. In addition, 100 families are supported in agriculture and with seeds so that they can better provide for themselves. Facilities are also provided so that people have access to clean water, toilets, and soap. This project is part of the Dutch Relief Alliance's Somalia Joint Response.
